sections.heading: Lift For Upliftment
paragraphs: "NGO started by Students of BJ Medical College, working to Uplift needy section of the society by Free Coaching of NEET(National Entrance cum Eligiblity Test) for admissions into MBBS and other Medical Cources." Since 2012, over 2,900 deserving students have been provided with educational assistance through the Lift for Upliftment Project.t: MMF supports an NGO run by the students at BJ Government College, Pune, that offers free coaching to underprivileged students for NEET (Medical Entrance Examinations). The programme consists of a regular lecture series and weekly practice conducted at the Bal Vikas Shikshan Sanstha Prathamik Shala, Pune.

sections.heading: Bharat Vikas Parishad
paragraphs: Bharat Vikas Parishad is a voluntary organization where citizens from all walks of life join to work for the development and growth of our country in all fields of human endeavour through promoting a sense of patriotism, national unity and integrity and culminating in Swasth-Samarth-Sanskarit Bharat i.e. physically, economically and morally strong India. Our work can be broadly categoried into Service (sewa) and Educational (sanskar). Serving the Divyang by manufacturing and providing them artificial limbs, taking up integrated village development of over 65 villages all over the country (providing tube-wells for water supply, toilets, constructing / renovating ponds, pathways, drains, class rooms, temples and even common crematoria), helping the tribal brethren, protecting environment by planting trees, organising health checkup and yoga camps, blood donation, setting up super specialty hospital and diagnostic centres, and whenever there is a national calamity, provide necessary help and undertake relief measures are some of the important Service projects. Our social compaigns include Beti Bachao – Beti Padhao and Nasha Mukti.
